mentions.title: Mercedes suffer one of the ‘toughest Fridays’ of the season
mentions.summary: Friday saw Mercedes’ new package of upgrades break cover in Malaysia, but the day did not go entirely to plan for the Silver Arrows, with some of their rivals getting out of the blocks faster in both practice sessions.

mentions.title: Azerbaijan GP was a step forward for upgraded Williams - but real test is still to come
mentions.summary:
If there is a definition of a mixed bag, that's what the Baku weekend was to Williams. It progressed to Q3 for the first time in 2026, but didn't start there due to a grid penalty for Carlos Sainz. It scored points for the first time since Monaco, with some fortune, but also saw Alex Albon crash out.

mentions.summary:
